title: LFU cache
statementMd:
Simulate an LFU cache. `['put', k, v]` stores (updating counts as a use if the key exists); when full, evict the least frequently used key, breaking ties by least recently used. `['get', k]` returns the value or -1 and counts as a use. Capacity 0 stores nothing. Return the results of get operations.

**Example:** `lfu_cache_ops(2, [["put", 1, 1], ["put", 2, 2], ["get", 1], ["put", 3, 3], […)` returns `[1, -1, 3, -1, 3, 4]`.
hints: Track frequency and a recency counter per key.
